Yes, in the latest run. Run-2 (12 Nov 2026) shows every day from 1 to 8 October 2026 covered by all four sensors (VIIRS S-NPP, NOAA-20, NOAA-21 and MODIS). It found no thermal detections intersecting the property (ASSET-F27) in that period.

The earlier run-1 (8 Oct 2026) was incomplete. It covered only 1–7 October, because the final day was still in progress or not yet published in the near-real-time files. Run-2 closes that gap, and it also found no detections.

One caveat: the results come from NASA FIRMS near-real-time data. The tool output doesn't say whether the data were later reprocessed. Also, "covered" here means the data files cover those days. It doesn't mean a satellite was guaranteed to observe the property each day, for example through clouds.
